newsitem.title: CHINA: China Shantou opens new urban co-op bank.
newsitem.headline: China Shantou opens new urban co-op bank.

text.p: China's Shantou city in southern Guangdong province has opened an urban cooperative bank to offer various banking services, the Financial News said on Tuesday.
The new urban cooperative bank has been approved by the People's Bank of China, the central bank, the newspaper said in an official announcement.
The bank's business scope would range from taking deposits, making loans and discounting bills to domestic settlement and issuing bonds, it said.
